Avatar — Avatar represents who — one person's identity in a compact circular form. It renders a photo when one is available and otherwise falls back to initials (a known user with no photo) or a person silhouette (unknown, anonymous, or pending identity), per the Soma Avatars page. — import { Avatar } from '@nova/ui' — status: In progress — impl: partial

Back Link — Link is the Soma inline hyperlink: text that takes the user somewhere else. Its job is to look like a link — color, underline, hover, focus — and to leave navigation itself to the element that owns the destination. — import { Link } from '@nova/ui' — status: Unknown — impl: matched
Badge — Badge is the Soma Badge: a passive status label, tag, or count indicator — `Completed`, `In progress`, `Draft`. It communicates status or classification at a glance and is never interactive, per the Soma Badges page. — import { Badge } from '@nova/ui' — status: Done — impl: matched

Button — Button renders a native `<button>` for actions. — import { Button } from '@nova/ui' — status: In progress — impl: partial
Card — `Card` is the first compound API in `libs/ui`. Every other component here flattens to a single function — even ones with a Base UI primitive underneath that is itself namespaced (`Switch` wraps `Switch.Root` / `Switch.Thumb` into one component). Card has no Base UI primitive at all — there is no accessible "card" role, so nothing is lost by not flattening it — and Soma's own sheet already models it as independent regions (a header with an optional trailing action, a body slot, an optional footer), not a fixed set of props. Exposing `Card.Root` / `Card.Header` / `Card.HeaderTitle` / `Card.Body` / `Card.Footer` as parts lets a consumer: — import { Card } from '@nova/ui' — status: Done — impl: partial
Card / Notice — `Card` is the first compound API in `libs/ui`. Every other component here flattens to a single function — even ones with a Base UI primitive underneath that is itself namespaced (`Switch` wraps `Switch.Root` / `Switch.Thumb` into one component). Card has no Base UI primitive at all — there is no accessible "card" role, so nothing is lost by not flattening it — and Soma's own sheet already models it as independent regions (a header with an optional trailing action, a body slot, an optional footer), not a fixed set of props. Exposing `Card.Root` / `Card.Header` / `Card.HeaderTitle` / `Card.Body` / `Card.Footer` as parts lets a consumer: — import { Card } from '@nova/ui' — status: Done — impl: partial

Chip — Chip is the Soma Chip: a compact pill that labels a discrete value the user has already supplied or the system has already applied — a selected filter, a recipient, an applied tag. Its job is to make that value visible and, when the value is removable, to carry the control that removes it. — import { Chip } from '@nova/ui' — status: In progress — impl: partial

Pagination — `Pagination` is the control that moves a user through a numbered page sequence. Use it anywhere a bounded list is split into pages — table footers (via `TablePagination`), card grids, search results — when the caller owns `page`, `pageCount`, and the fetch/slice logic. — import { Pagination } from '@nova/ui' — status: Done — impl: partial

Progress Bar — Progress is the Soma Progress Bar: a determinate, horizontal indicator that shows how much of a known-length task has completed — an upload, a multi-step form, a wizard. Phase 1 is the determinate bar only, per the Soma Progress Indicators page; the file groups the bar and an indeterminate Spinner under the same page, and only the bar is in scope here. — import { Progress } from '@nova/ui' — status: Done — impl: matched
Radio / Control — Radio is the Soma Radio / Control: a 16×16 circle expressing one choice in a mutually exclusive set. Exactly one member of a group is selected, and selecting one deselects the rest. Phase 1 is the control plus the group that owns its value — default tone, one size — per the Soma Radio page. — import { Radio } from '@nova/ui' — status: In progress — impl: matched

Select / Field — SelectField is a select with a label. It is the component product code should reach for whenever a user picks one value from a list inside a form, and it exists so that the label, the help text, the error message, and the required marker are supplied once, as strings, rather than assembled by every consumer. — import { SelectField } from '@nova/ui' — status: Blocked — impl: partial
Select / Field Multi — TODO — no code import — status: Blocked — impl: not-implemented
Select / Item — Select is the Soma Select: choose exactly one value from a known, finite list, collapsed behind a trigger until it is needed. It is the right control when the options are enumerable and the user does not need to see them all at once — a country, an assignee, a status. — import { Select } from '@nova/ui' — status: Blocked — impl: partial
